answer_1.quote: We create preference data using a multi-agent, recursive tree-based paradigm... Agents debate each other, acting as both speakers and listeners to create a dialogue tree... We evaluate teams of two models... measuring model accuracy at the start and end of the dialogue.

answer_2.quote: We use the 'Logical' strategy, which gives a logical argument for why the misinformation is true and is generally the most effective, and use Xu et al. (2024)'s evaluation, measuring the rate at which the target is misinformed (lower is better). We also report accuracy before and after discussion, misinformation rate, and flip‑flopping rate.
